Before you begin:
Do not save over this master file.
Use Save As to create your own team copy.
Rename it using your team letter/name, for example:
TEAMA_Ghostbusters_HUNT_Submission.xlsx
Save your copy in your private Teams channel.
Keep working in and updating that same copy throughout the challenge.
Make sure your latest version is saved in your private Teams channel before each checkpoint.

TEST 1 — unseen 10% of the data
Run your working Monster Detector on the TEST 1 dataset and submit the P_IDs your detector identifies for each monster type.  

Your slides explain your detector and results; this workbook records its output..

Choose ONE submission route:

OPTION A — AUTO COMBINE
Enter P_IDs on the individual monster tabs. The AUTO COMBINED sheet builds the final list automatically.

OPTION B — MANUAL COMBINE
Paste/type Monster Type + P_ID directly into the MANUAL COMBINED sheet.

You do not need to complete both routes.
